# Dipp Blog

> > Insights on ecommerce strategy, visual design automation, and brand marketing across Taiwan and global markets

Dipp (點譜數位) publishes case studies, marketing guides, and industry analysis focused on ecommerce platforms (momo, PChome, Shopee), visual design systems, and brand strategies for Taiwan and international markets. Content covers shopping festivals (618, Double 11), Gen Z consumer behavior, and creative automation workflows.

## Key Topics

- Visual Design & Creative Automation
- Taiwan Ecommerce (momo, PChome, Shopee)
- Brand Strategy & Positioning
- Shopping Festival Marketing (618, Double 11)
- Multi-Channel Retail & D2C
- Gen Z Consumer Behavior
- Social Commerce (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok)
- Influencer Marketing
- Marketing Automation
- Subscription Models
- Product Launch Strategy
- Second-Mover Advantage
- Agency Case Studies (欣新網)
- Ecommerce Trends 2025

## Ecommerce Strategy & Trends

- [(NEW!) 2025 E-Commerce Trends and Strategies to Stay Ahead](https://blog.withdipp.com/en/2025-ecommerce-trends): 2025 ecommerce predictions: D2C growth, fast delivery, market fragmentation
- [5 traits of Gen Z's shopping behaviour](https://blog.withdipp.com/en/5-traits-of-gen-zs-shopping-behaviour): Gen Z Asia-Pacific shopping: TikTok influence, UGC, social commerce trends
- [蝦皮開店攻略:抓住超過千萬買家的商機,打造高轉換品牌首頁](https://blog.withdipp.com/zh-tw/set-up-your-shopee-store): Complete Shopee store setup guide from account to homepage optimization
- [流量太貴?電商必試四大流量來源](https://blog.withdipp.com/zh-tw/four-traffic-for-ecommerce): Four essential traffic sources for ecommerce: social, search, native, influencer
- [錯把促銷當目的,身為專業工作者不應該隨著老闆起舞](https://blog.withdipp.com/zh-tw/promotions-cannot-be-your-brand-goal): Why ecommerce brands shouldn't rely solely on promotions for growth

- [由「今晚,我想來點」的洗腦台詞來論 Uber Eats 品牌行銷的成敗](https://blog.withdipp.com/zh-tw/discussion-of-uber-eats-ad-tonight-i-will-be-eating): Analysis of Uber Eats Taiwan ad campaign and brand localization strategy
